text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I peek into the dance studio and see
Aston
Machan and Daiwa Scarlet in the
middle of a
dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Would it be wrong if we just
sang without
dancing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, a winning concert isn't really
complete
without the dancing...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So let's keep trying a little longer. And
don't
worry, you're already doing much
better than
before!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, hi. Yes, I'm trying my best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I really am, but it's hopeless. I keep
tripping up
over my own legs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Just watch. One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oof.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What a mess. Why are my legs so all
over the
place?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe you're stressed out by all
the
moves. Should we try doing fewer
steps?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The routine's already quite simple,
though. I don't
think that's it...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I hadn't thought of that. How
would it
help?
choice_data_list: Then why not try increasing it even more?
Let's take a break and clear our heads.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that she might be better off
moving on
every beat rather than
leaving pauses between
the steps.
choice_data_list: Because you're better at precise movements.
Because you're better with subtle movements.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You mean like this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh... Oh?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's amazing! You're so much
lighter on
your feet than before!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainers really do keep a close eye on
their
trainees, huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I did it. I feel like I've mastered my own
special
technique.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm one step closer to becoming a
super ultra
mascot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her new technique, Aston Machan
finishes
polishing up her dance routine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, breaks really are important. Okay,
let's take
a breather.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Once I cleared my mind, I came up with
a great
idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So, for example...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I use these, I can guide their gaze. It's

misdirection.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Eye-catching items make mascots much
more
appealing too. This way, everyone
will focus up
here instead of on my legs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In fact, if we take this idea to its
extreme, we
might be able to get away
with no steps
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Guiding their gaze... Interesting...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And completely out of the question!
C'mon, back
to practicing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With some encouragement from her
friend, Aston
Machan finally overcomes
her dancing difficulties.
